scientific_integrity: Complete proof uses a smooth genus-one curve point bound, Hensel lifting, and a finite cubic-coset classification. Verification code supplies finite consistency checks but not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The criterion is limited to primes other than three and diagonal cubics with three nonzero integer coefficients. Surjectivity is over local coordinates; integer-coordinate quotients are dense. The distinct-valuation complement and all-three-equal case are prior-covered, not separately claimed as novel. Publication priority is not independently certified.
title: A complete local density criterion for diagonal ternary cubic quotient sets
